summary: Completed comprehensive testing of volunteer registration edit mode. All 9 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. Edit mode correctly activates with token in URL, shows 'Editar Postulación' title, displays 6 steps (without Verificación), loads existing data, allows navigation, shows 'Guardar Cambios' button, and successfully updates registration. Invalid tokens correctly show error and fall back to normal registration mode.
critical_code_review_comments: Edit mode implementation is clean with separate EDIT_STEPS array (6 steps) vs STEPS array (7 steps)
Token-based authentication for edit mode is secure - edit_token is not exposed in API responses
Error handling for invalid tokens is correct - shows toast and falls back to normal registration
Form data loading and persistence works correctly via loadExistingRegistration function
Update endpoint correctly validates required fields and returns 422 for incomplete data
